preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 100000 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) and len(s) == 2*n and all(c in '01' for c in s) for n, s in zip(ns, ss))
preconditions.description: For each test case, s is a binary string of length 2n.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all((isinstance(m, int) and 0 <= m <= 2*n and isinstance(b, list) and len(b) == m and all(isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= 2*n for x in b) and b == sorted(b) and len(set(b)) == m) or (m == -1 and b == []) for n, m, b in zip(ns, ms, bs))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if a solution exists, m is the count of indices in b, b is a list of m distinct indices in increasing order within [1, 2n]; if no solution, m is -1 and b is empty.

postconditions.expression: all((isinstance(p, list) and len(p) == n and all(isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= 2*n for x in p) and p == sorted(p) and len(set(p)) == n) or (m == -1 and p == []) for n, m, p in zip(ns, ms, ps))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if a solution exists, p is a list of n distinct indices in increasing order within [1, 2n]; if no solution, p is empty.

postconditions.expression: all((m == -1) or (apply_rotation(s, b) == construct_subsequence(apply_rotation(s, b), p) + construct_subsequence(apply_rotation(s, b), [i for i in range(1, 2*n+1) if i not in p])) for n, s, m, b, p in zip(ns, ss, ms, bs, ps))
postconditions.description: If a solution is provided (m != -1), the string s after applying the rotation defined by b must be partitionable into two equal subsequences defined by indices p and its complement.

postconditions.expression: all((m == -1) or (construct_subsequence(apply_rotation(s, b), p) == construct_subsequence(apply_rotation(s, b), [i for i in range(1, 2*n+1) if i not in p])) for n, s, m, b, p in zip(ns, ss, ms, bs, ps))
postconditions.description: If a solution is provided, the subsequence formed by indices p must be identical to the subsequence formed by the remaining indices.
